SIVA KESAVA REDDY POLIMERA divyaram8162@gmail.com |8608361277

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Investment Banking and Fund Accounting professional with 7+ years of experience in portfolio reconciliation, NAV validation, client reporting, trade life cycle management, investment operations, and liquidity reporting. Experienced in handling equities, bonds, OTC instruments, funds, and cash operations across global financial institutions. Strong expertise in stakeholder management, process improvement, audit compliance, and reporting automation.

CORE SKILLS

Fund Accounting | NAV Validation | Portfolio Reconciliation | Investment Operations | Trade Booking | OTC Instrument Setup | Liquidity Reporting | Cash & Position Reconciliation | Client Reporting | Bloomberg | Aladdin | Excel Reporting | Audit & Compliance | Stakeholder Management | Process Automation | Risk Reporting

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Investment Accounting Analyst — Lancesoft India

Dec 2025 – July 2026

Managing portfolio reconciliation activities for wealth management clients. ● Handling trade booking and validation for equities, bonds, funds, FCN, and OTC instruments. ● Managing end-to-end trade life cycle activities including trade capture, settlement, and reconciliation.

Performing cash and position reconciliation across investment portfolios. ● Supporting financial reporting, valuations, and client deliverables with high accuracy.

Assistant Manager — WNS Global Services – AI/BNY Mellon

Feb 2022 – Jul 2024

Managed weekly, monthly, and quarterly fund reporting deliverables for global clients. ● Prepared and reviewed fund factsheets, liquidity reports, investment commentary, and client reports.



Led a team of 3 members and handled review and approval activities for fund reports.

Worked with portfolio managers and global stakeholders for risk ratings, reporting validation, and audit requirements.

Contributed to SOP documentation, client onboarding, and automation initiatives reducing operational effort.

Senior Associate — State Street Corporation

Jul 2018 – Oct 2021

Managed NAV oversight and valuation activities for North American clients.

Performed reconciliations, exception management, issue resolution, and quality control reviews. ● Ensured timely delivery of pricing and valuation activities as per SLA deadlines. ● Participated in client meetings and process improvement initiatives. Oct 2016 – Jul 2018

Performed reconciliations, exception management, issue resolution, and quality control reviews. ● Ensured timely delivery of pricing and valuation activities as per SLA deadlines. ● Participated in client meetings and process improvement initiatives. Oct 2016 – Jul 2018

Handled unit pricing and fund accounting activities for Australian clients. ● Performed NAV pricing validation for equities, futures, swaps, and forwards.

Conducted cash flow analysis, fee accrual validations, and reconciliations. ● Supported month-end reporting, journals, valuation reports, and tax reports.

KEY PROJECTS & ACHIEVEMENTS

Worked on automation of manual investment reporting workflows with Beacon team. ● Suggested Excel macro solutions reducing report preparation time by 50%. ● Handled versatility and process transition projects with global teams. ● Supported process optimization initiatives for error-free NAV delivery.

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

Aladdin, Bloomberg, Explore, MCH, Morningstar Publishing System (MPS), TLM, IntelliMatch, Cash Flow Dashboard, Hiport, P Control, Wealth Pulse, Metabase, CBonds, Polyglot, MS Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint

EDUCATION

MBA — VIT Business School | 2012 – 2014

ADDITIONAL STRENGTHS

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities ● Expertise in investment banking operations and reporting ● Ability to manage stakeholders and cross-functional teams ● Experience in audit, compliance, and process controls
